test_title: PYST 49: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: During the first year, the population of a village increased by 5%, and during the second year, it reduced by 6%. At the end of the second year, its population was 35,532. What was the population at the beginning of the first year?
solution:
**Given:**

Population at the end of the second year = 35,532

Population increased by 5% in the first year.

Population reduced by 6% in the second year.

**Formula Used:**

Population at the beginning = Population at the end / (1 + Percentage increase in decimal) / (1 - Percentage decrease in decimal)

**Calculation:**

Let the population at the beginning of the first year be P.

Population after the first year = P × (1 + 5/100) = P × 1
.05

Population after the second year = (P × 1.05) × (1 - 6/100) = (P × 1.05) × 0.94

At the end of the second year, population = 35,532

⇒ P × 1.05 × 0.94 = 35,532

⇒ P = 35,532 / (1.05 × 0.94)

⇒ P = 35,532 / 0.987

⇒ P = 36,000

**The population at the beginning of the first year was 36,000.**
